PLAYER EXACT "Yes" at Day289~14:10 Nightglass Hall records room, directly in response to Edric's explicit OFFER: "Would you like Edric to request that copy while we examine Nightglass Hall's older Verdana and Vaishnavi records?" Accept BOTH limited actions: Edric to initiate the ordinary lawful request for the separate Orsaven later post-Convergence surveyor FIELD BOOK (not physically at Nightglass) and V/companions to examine the Hall's accessible older Verdana/Vaishnavi reference indexes with Edric's existing invitation/authority. This is NO directive to buy something, abandon Hall for Orsaven, request magical divination, seize originals, enter heart reliquary, sign a feudal oath, or travel to unknown ruin. Exact prior accepted checkpoint from PLAY-REC-D289-V-INVESTIGATES-NIGHTGLASS-HEART-PACKING-NOTES-001 is DAY289~14:10 Nightglass supervised records room: old original heart recovery/packing waypoint SERVICE-HOUSE DISTRICT OUTER LOADING, earlier V Investigation advantage12+skill3+attuned Luckstone1=16 vsDC16 established original mark/transport layer vs later storytelling; Orsaven geographically independent post-Convergence survey was still remote, request not yet initiated. New user Yes means Edric, as existing long-time steward and scholar, independently drafts, signs and gives house clerk a specific ordinary written REQUEST to the known ORSAVEN COLLECTION keeper for a faithful surveyor field-book COPY of the old district crossing, hauling-frame reference, surrounding topography, source/date/copy annotations and original marginalia. Household ordinary professional work and outgoing correspondence are in Edric's remit; no personal V charge/deposit/limited resource, public permission check or spurious clerk task. The signed request is logged in NIGHTGLASS HOUSEHOLD OUTGOING TRAY for NEXT REGULAR POST as of Day289 ~14:20; NOT yet actually shown to have departed the grounds, reached Orsaven, been accepted/read or produced returned certified image. No invented dispatch ETA, faster-than-travel response, telepathic delivery, fee, automatic official warrant or remote access. Original field book stays Orsaven; when/if faithful copy eventually arrives Edric can compare on-site and arrange sharing by authorized real contact route; V has not chosen to wait for it. 
Between ~14:20 and14:45 Edric permits V, Mara, Cirren and Fenar to examine existing NONSENSITIVE Hall historical index at writing table. No new source was silently invented as a 1200-year-old eyewitness genealogy: the accessible later Hall household INDICES actually attach names VERDANA, HOUSE VAISHNAVI and SILVER COURT to older recovery/custody narratives; they are administrative HISTORICAL ATTRIBUTIONS rather than signed dated dynastic originals. Records continue to support a documentary HEART transport/packing association with former service-house district and an origin PROPOSAL linked to Verdana, but they do NOT establish where manufactured, voice's creator, parentage, V's personal ancient name/title, Lord Severin's ancient superior or a modern legal sovereign claim. Mara independently with antiquarian familiarity observes old source references have been copied/repeated in later comments; Cirren points out each copy is not independent corroboration, Edric accepts documentary limits, none claims a contemporary birth ledger in Nightglass. Prior player-known 2014 campaign Silver Court SIGNET motif from old Nightglass visit is a DISTINCT seal from ordinary carrier's TRANSPORT MARK; similar narrative association does not turn both into an equal legal signatory or genealogical proof; no new detailed symbol drawing, seal owner, supernatural aura or family designation confirmed. No additional ability check is needed for readable records and established author/source annotations; previous genuinely executed Investigation16 already covered finer stratigraphy, do not reroll/gate baseline research. Old physical Hall originals remain Edric's custodial ownership, Edric's copied reference notes/tracing continue in Hall. Mara continues her already established working comparison notes; no new physical original/official certified copy moved to party. The party remains at NIGHTGLASS Hall records room around DAY289~14:45. Previously V proposed possible restored senior VAISHNAVI political affiliation preserving independent House SEVERIN name/holdings/autonomy and reciprocal protection; EDric agreed to advocate but Lord Severin not here, no actual peerage recognition/transaction. V's Rethwyn compact privately signed and held original in Cirren documents; no new Crown public marriage recognized or new resources; estate finances unaffected. 
Current V HP48/48 AC19 HD7/7 Sup4/4 Psi6/6 MP7/7 PastLife3/3 PsiRecovery1/1 ActionSurge1/1 SecondWind1/1 first freeWhispers1/1, both Cloak of Protection and Stone of Good Luck ON PERSON ATTUNED 2/3 slots, Luckstone +1 checks/saves incl initiative and appropriate passives but NOT AC/attack/damage. Fenar HP59/59 HD6/6 Rage4/4 inactive Shift3/3 MP6/6 CLIMB40; Cirren HP51/51 full cleric slots L1 4/4,L2 3/3,L3 3/3,CD2/2; Mara healthy; four V horses and coach intact in Hall courtyard with water but no overnight booking/payments. Purse329gp1sp6cp, 21 ration person-days/28 horse-feed animal-days, sealed Pixie Dust1, weighted LongRest5/6, no food/hay stock/spell/new rest consumed by 35 minutes of lawful archival work. V original regional station Kestrel authorization, Evermarch/Clear Will experimental orders, transfer/requisition ledger, two false clinical admin folios and signed medical investigation papers, mage pouch all V-held undisclosed; Mara Neri notes and new documentary working annotations; Fenar six sealed vials and silver measuring instrument in padded case unchanged. Eleven freed patients remain under already paid care at Sedgecross with earlier optional Blackthorn invitation, no news/courier arrived. NEXT action may address source questions, request specific local copies, ask Edric to summon/arrange Lord Severin audience (notification already sent), explore another authorized reference, or arrange guest overnight if offered by actual caretaker; never auto-accept unknown site expedition or future town travel.
